app.skipToContent: Keyboard skip link at the top of the window; jumps past the sidebar to the page.
app.windowTitle: Window title. {page} is the current page's name (one of the route.* messages, or a playlist/section name). Keep "OxiTide".
route.nowPlaying: Page name: the full-screen view of the playing track.
route.home: Page name in the sidebar and window title.
route.feed: Page name: new releases from followed artists.
route.stats: Page name: listening statistics (a tab of History).
route.folder: Fallback name of a playlist folder that has no name.
route.albums: Page name: the user's saved albums.
route.tracks: Page name: the user's favorite tracks.
route.later: Page name: TIDAL's "Save for Later" list. Use the glossary term.
route.mixes: Page name: TIDAL mixes and radio stations.
route.profiles: Page name: the artists the user follows.
route.purchases: Page name: tracks and albums the user bought.
route.album: Window title while an album page is open.
route.playlist: Window title while a playlist page is open.
route.artist: Window title while an artist page is open.
route.mix: Window title while a mix page is open.
route.radio: Window title: a radio station built from one track.
player.openNowPlaying: Button on the player bar's cover thumbnail; opens the full-screen Now Playing view.
player.artwork: Image description for screen readers. {title} is the track title.
player.favorite: Button: add the playing track to favorites (verb).
player.unfavorite: Button: remove the playing track from favorites (verb).
player.waitingForNetwork: Small lowercase status next to the time while the stream buffers.
player.repeatOneLabel: Repeat toggle's screen-reader name when it repeats the current track.
player.repeatOne: Repeat toggle's tooltip: repeats the current track.
player.repeatAll: Repeat toggle: repeats the whole queue.
player.queue: Button that opens the play queue panel.
player.queueHint: Tooltip of the queue button. {key} is its keyboard shortcut (a single key such as Q).
player.qualityLabel: Screen-reader name of the quality button. {tier} is a quality name (Max, High…; not translated), {spec} a format such as "24-bit 96 kHz" or "none", {path} is bitPerfect, dsp or none. Translate only the words inside the braces' branches.
player.streamingQuality: Tooltip of the quality button while a track streams.
player.preferredQuality: Tooltip of the quality button before anything streams.
player.bitPerfect: Tooltip of the BP badge: the audio reaches the device unchanged.
player.miniPlayer: Button: switch to the small always-on-top player window.
player.nothingStreaming: Quality menu note when no track is streaming.
player.nothingPlaying: Player bar text when the queue is empty.
toast.dismiss: Close button on a notification (screen-reader name).
settings.language.label: Settings row: picks the interface language.
settings.language.description: Help text under the Language row.
settings.language.system: Picker option that follows the operating system. {language} is the matched language's own name (e.g. Deutsch); keep it as is.
settings.language.machine: Tag next to a language whose translation was made by a machine and not yet checked by a person.
settings.language.crossChecked: Tag next to a machine translation that a second model checked (Chinese).
settings.language.pseudo: Development-only test language with accented, longer text.
settings.language.helpTranslate: Link to the guide for fixing translations or adding a language.
